title: k8s-drain-surge
description: Helm values for the k8s-drain-surge controller.

replicaCount.description: Number of controller pods. Leader election picks one active leader; >=2 is recommended for HA so a node failure does not pause reconciliation.

repository.description: Container image repository for the controller.

tag.description: Image tag. Empty string falls back to Chart.AppVersion.

drainTaints.description: Node taint keys/effects that trigger a drain-surge. Defaults cover Karpenter, Cluster Autoscaler, and kubectl drain.

readinessTimeout.description: Go duration. Time the controller waits for a surged pod to become Ready before aborting and restoring original replicas. Must be > requeueInterval. Windows pods may need 15m+.

requeueInterval.description: Go duration. Poll interval between state-machine reconciles. Smaller = faster reaction, more API server load.

leaderElect.description: Enable leader election. Required when replicaCount > 1.

restartSurge.description: Restart-surge protects single-replica Argo Rollouts whose `kubectl argo rollouts restart` is blocked indefinitely by a PDB (Argo's PodRestarter uses the eviction API). Argo Rollouts only.

enabled.description: Opt in to restart-surge. Off by default; only useful with Argo Rollouts.

gracePeriod.description: Go duration. Wait this long after spec.restartAt before triggering a surge — lets Argo finish on its own when the PDB permits.

timeout.description: Go duration. Total budget for one restart-surge operation. Abort and restore on overrun.

priorityClassName.description: Pod priorityClassName. system-cluster-critical keeps the controller alive during node pressure.

resources.description: Resource requests/limits for the controller container.

create.description: Create a dedicated ServiceAccount. Set false to reuse an existing one (see .name).

annotations.description: Annotations on the ServiceAccount (e.g. IRSA / Workload Identity bindings).
